Ruling 16 (several review items per PR): review.head-advanced never reopens a closed review item. The head advanced past the head the closed item was reviewed at, no unclaimed item exists, and no item has the current head_sha, so the rule creates ONE new review item for the current head (title review-pr: <repo>#<n> @ <short head>, dedup key with the head suffix). The old sync reopened and refreshed the one item instead, and its plan lists only the adoption of the existing item, so the create has no old counterpart: it is the intended difference, pinned here.
